run_f_gold: run f_gold(n) to count binary strings of length n that contain consecutive 1s
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in test harness with 10 parameter sets
summarize_f_gold: summarize the dynamic programming approach in f_gold that uses two arrays to track binary string endings
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand how it subtracts non-consecutive-1s strings from the total 2^n
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use O(1) space instead of O(n) arrays for the DP computation
